code:
RPO  ~ archive_command interval
     (not time since last base backup)

RTO  ~ base backup restore time
     + WAL replay time since that backup

Fresher base backup -> less WAL to replay -> faster RTO
caption: Periodic pg_basebackup runs matter even though WAL alone could replay from anywhere.
